clean.generator: keying_intervals('CQ TEST K1ABC K1ABC', 25 WPM) from 1.0 s, duration last key-up + 3 s, S500 20 dB, seed 1 (test_decodes_a_clean_station)

clean_2000.generator: as clean, generated at 2000 samples/s (Review Focus 5)

farnsworth.generator: timed_intervals('CQ TEST K1ABC', 18 WPM, farnsworth_wpm 10 WPM) from 1.0 s, duration last key-up + 1 s + 3 s, S500 20 dB, seed 5 (test_proto_channel.farnsworth)

first_sample.generator: as clean from 0.0 s, duration last key-up + 3 s, S500 20 dB, seed 2 (test_decodes_a_station_from_the_first_sample)

long.generator: keying_intervals('CQ TEST K1ABC' x 8, 20 WPM) from 1.0 s, duration last key-up + 3 s, S500 8 dB, seed 9 (test_corrections_never_reach_back_more_than_20_s)

noise.generator: noise alone, 30 s, S500 20 dB, seed 6 (test_noise_alone_leaves_no_text)

noise_tail.generator: keying_intervals('TEST K1ABC', 25 WPM) from 1.0 s, then 8 s of noise alone (duration last key-up + 1 s + 8 s), S500 20 dB, seed 13

short.generator: noise alone, 0.3 s, S500 20 dB, seed 10 (test_short_and_empty_streams)

slow.generator: keying_intervals('HI HI TEST', 12 WPM) from 1.0 s, duration last key-up + 4 s, S500 20 dB, seed 3 (test_slow_first_word_is_right_after_corrections)

speed_turnover.generator: keying_intervals('CQ DE K1ABC K', 15 WPM), then 3 s after its last key-up keying_intervals('TEST DE W9XYZ W9XYZ K', 30 WPM), from 1.0 s, duration last key-up + 4 s, S500 20 dB, seed 12 (test_a_speed_change_across_a_turnover_is_taken_up)

step.generator: timed_intervals('CQ CQ CQ DE K1ABC K1ABC K1ABC K1ABC', 15 WPM, wpm_end 30 WPM, profile 'step') from 1.0 s, duration last key-up + 1 s + 3 s, S500 20 dB, seed 4 (test_follows_a_speed_step_within_ten_marks)

tune_up.generator: a 2 s carrier, then keying_intervals('CQ TEST K1ABC K1ABC', 25 WPM) 2.5 s after its start, from 1.0 s, duration last key-up + 4 s, S500 20 dB, seed 8 (test_a_tune_up_carrier_does_not_derail_decoding)

turnover.generator: keying_intervals('CQ DE K1ABC K', 25 WPM), then 3 s after its last key-up keying_intervals('EE TT EE TT K1ABC', 25 WPM), from 1.0 s, duration last key-up + 4 s, S500 20 dB, seed 7 (test_proto_channel.same_speed_turnover)

two_speeds.generator: keying_intervals('CQ DE K1ABC K', 25 WPM), then 2 s after its last key-up keying_intervals('K1ABC DE W9XYZ K', 15 WPM), from 1.0 s, duration last key-up + 4 s, S500 20 dB, seed 7 (test_two_overs_at_different_speeds)

zero_pad.generator: 1500 samples (1 s) of exact zeros, then keying_intervals('CQ TEST K1ABC', 25 WPM) from 0.5 s, duration last key-up + 3.5 s, S500 20 dB, seed 14 (a zero-padded first-sample recording; Review Focus 3)
